title: Culture Museums
intro: One cultural anchor per day — no museum marathons. September Beijing is less crowded than summer peak. Hội An is a living cultural museum. Early opening slots essential for crowd avoidance. Both travelers in excellent shape for walking-heavy sites.

rows: Ngoc Son Temple + Temple of Literature

rows: 8 AM before tour buses or after 5 PM lanterns; UNESCO ticket ~120,000 VND (5 sites); 2–3 sites max
7:30 AM opening; Groups B/C/D off main path; hire local guide (~$5–10); 1.5–2 hrs

bullets.heading: Alternative Culture
items: Beijing: Peking Opera at Lao She Teahouse (~$30/person, English surtitles); White Cloud Temple (active Taoist monastery, free)
Hanoi: Water Puppet Theatre (~$5–8, book 1–2 days ahead); Tay Ho West Lake neighborhood walk
Hội An: Lantern-making class (~$10/person); Phuc Kien Assembly Hall (1697, active worship)

bullets.heading: China → Vietnam Cultural Shifts
items: Greeting: Chinese nod/slight bow → Vietnamese bow or two-hand handshake
Dining: hot tea → iced coffee and iced tea
Pace: fast Beijing → slower Hanoi and Hội An
Religion: secular/Taoist/Buddhist Beijing → actively Buddhist Vietnam
Transition is significant but positive — Vietnam feels warmer (temperature and people)

bullets.heading: Survival Phrases — China
items: 你好 (Nǐ hǎo) — Hello; 谢谢 (Xièxiè) — Thank you; 多少钱 — How much?
我不要 — I don't want it; 帮我叫滴滴 — Call me a DiDi; 厕所在哪里 — Where is the toilet?
English: low outside luxury hotels/tourist sites; Google Translate camera mode essential

bullets.heading: Survival Phrases — Vietnam
items: Xin chào — Hello; Cảm ơn — Thank you; Bao nhiêu tiền? — How much?
Không — No; Gọi cho tôi Grab — Call me a Grab
English: high in tourist zones (Hội An, Old Quarter, Đà Nẵng resorts); lower in rural/markets

callouts.text: Forbidden City tickets MUST be booked online in advance — timed entry, no walk-up sales
Hội An Ancient Town: don't hit all 5 UNESCO sites — 2–3 is the sweet spot for relaxed pace
No consecutive heavy museum days; max 2 cultural sites/day; resort days (9, 11, 13) are full recovery
All major sites have early-entry crowd avoidance strategy
